steps.instruction: In this project-management app, open the edit form for the line item '{{runid}} MTP Item A' (Project Items tab, project '{{runid}} MTP Bench Project'). The app refuses to save status 'Specified' until these fields are completed: Supplier, Supplier Code, Item Cost, Item Units, Unit. Fill them in with sensible values: pick an existing Supplier from the available options (there are Organisations in the app — choose one that is a supplier), set Supplier Code to 'MTP-A', set Item Cost to 150, set Item Units to 1, and pick a Unit (e.g. each / pcs / whatever options exist). Keep Status as 'Specified' and Budget Cost 150, Budget Margin 25. Then submit/save. If further validation errors appear, report their exact text and address them too. Once saved, verify in the Project Items LIST view that the item's status is now 'Specified' and report the status marker/text, plus exactly which fields you had to fill and with what values.
